review: Like FNAF 4 and FNAF Sister Location, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator brings a unique look to the FNAF horror formula with it's new tycoon mode. The tycoon mode's cute aspect perfectly meshes with the typical horror aspect to make a truly fun game to add to the series.
